items.name: Bargain Hunter
items.title: Bargain Hunter – UK Price Comparison, Tracker & Discount Codes
items.summary: Cheapest UK price in your size across shops, outlets and sales, with price drop alerts, inflated-price warnings and discount codes.

items.name: FraudFence
items.title: FraudFence – Investment & Crypto Scam Shield
items.summary: Warns you about fake investment sites, FCA-flagged firms, crypto scams, honeypot tokens and rug pulls before you send money.

items.name: Hindsight
items.title: Hindsight – Stock & Crypto Prices Since Posted
items.summary: Hover any $ticker on X, Reddit or the news to see the price, a chart and how much it has moved since the post was written.

items.name: Sussed
items.title: Sussed – Fake Review & Rip-off Checker
items.summary: Spot fake reviews, hidden fees, pre-ticked extras and fake countdowns before you buy. Private: checks run in your browser.

items.name: Ticklist
items.title: Ticklist – Calendar Checklists, Daily Planner & Task Carry-over
items.summary: Checklists on Google Calendar events, a daily list that plans itself, and unfinished tasks that carry over with their notes.

items.name: Homing
items.title: Homing: Crypto Address Book & Name Lookup
items.summary: Save the people you pay in crypto, look up names like alice.eth or alice@wallet, and catch lookalike addresses when you paste.

items.name: Calmview
items.title: Calmview: Ad Blocker for YouTube and the Web
items.summary: Blocks ads, trackers and pop-ups on every site, YouTube included, so pages load faster. One switch per site. Private by design.

items.name: Job Autopilot
items.title: Job Autopilot
items.summary: Finds remote contract and freelance roles on Reed, LinkedIn, ComputerJobs and remote job boards through the day, applies (on the sites, on Greenhouse forms, or by email with your CV) and tracks the replies in Gmail.
